items.name: app-icon-studio
items.description: Apple app icons: create, generate, evaluate, export, install, or debug iOS AppIcon.appiconset and macOS .icns assets for small-size clarity.

items.name: apple-dev-research
items.description: Apple developer articles: search Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, iOS, and macOS community blogs, tutorials, and write-ups, not official docs.

items.name: apple-firmware-inspector
items.description: Apple firmware: inspect and reverse-engineer IPSWs, kernelcaches, dyld shared caches, private headers, entitlements, Mach-O binaries, KEXTs, and security internals with `ipsw`.

items.name: appstore-ads-operator
items.description: Apple Ads campaigns: inspect and manage separate auth, orgs, ad groups, creatives, keywords, reports, and API calls; approve live mutations first.

items.name: appstore-archive-uploader
items.description: App Store IPA/PKG archives: set version/build numbers, archive, export, upload, or publish with `asc xcode` before TestFlight/App Store submission.

items.name: appstore-aso-auditor
items.description: App Store ASO audit: analyze canonical `./metadata` offline after `asc metadata pull`; add Astro MCP keyword gaps and Apple app-tag context when available.

items.name: appstore-build-monitor
items.description: App Store builds: track processing, find latest builds and next numbers, wait on uploads, or safely expire old builds with `asc`.

items.name: appstore-connect-cli
items.description: App Store Connect commands: discover and run generic `asc` CLI auth, schemas, canonical verbs, pagination, output, records, API requests, and timeouts; exclude Apple Ads campaigns.

items.name: appstore-crash-insights
items.description: TestFlight crash reports: triage crashes, beta feedback, hangs, disk writes, launches, and performance diagnostics with `asc`.

items.name: appstore-id-resolver
items.description: App Store Connect IDs: resolve apps, builds, versions, groups, testers, and review submissions from names with deterministic `asc` lookups.

items.name: appstore-metadata-localizer
items.description: App Store listing text: translate and market-adapt descriptions, keywords, What's New, names, subtitles, and privacy text across locales. Excludes non-translation edits, standalone release notes, and IAP/subscription names.

items.name: appstore-metadata-sync
items.description: App Store metadata JSON: edit, validate, push, or sync canonical `./metadata`, plus legacy fastlane migration via `asc migrate`. Excludes translation-first work, standalone release notes, and IAP/subscription names.

items.name: appstore-notary-runner
items.description: macOS Developer ID notarization commands for xcodebuild export, `asc notarization` submit/status/log, and stapling. Excludes packaging-readiness reviews and signing-only diagnosis.

items.name: appstore-pricing-planner
items.description: App Store subscription and IAP pricing by territory with `asc`, including price points, PPP/localized CSV imports, availability, summaries, and schedules; mutating actions require confirmation.

items.name: appstore-record-creator
items.description: App Store Connect New App creation via visible browser automation after bundle-ID registration for the API-less web form; never store cookies or auto-retry Create.

items.name: appstore-release-director
items.description: iOS App Store release orchestration from a local repo through signing, metadata, privacy, screenshots, upload, TestFlight, review submission/resubmission, blocker triage, and release evidence.

items.name: appstore-release-notes-writer
items.description: App Store What's New notes and promotional text from git history, bullets, or prose, with optional localization. Excludes full-listing translation, metadata sync, and subscription/IAP names.

items.name: appstore-release-planner
items.description: App Store release go/no-go planning for readiness, first-submission blockers, sequencing, and stage-versus-submit decisions. Routes execution to focused skills; review commands belong to appstore-review-readiness.

items.name: appstore-revenuecat-sync
items.description: App Store Connect and RevenueCat subscription/IAP reconciliation with `asc` and RevenueCat MCP for catalog bootstrap, drift audits, deterministic product/entitlement/offering/package mapping, and no deletions.

items.name: appstore-review-readiness
items.description: App Store review-readiness execution with current `asc` commands to validate, stage, submit, monitor, cancel, or repair blockers after go/no-go planning. Excludes release strategy; appstore-release-planner owns it.

items.name: appstore-screenshot-pipeline
items.description: iOS App Store screenshot automation with xcodebuild/simctl capture, AXe plans, Koubou framing, review artifacts, and `asc` upload.

items.name: appstore-screenshot-studio
items.description: App Store marketing screenshot creation and revision to translate, scrape, crop, and validate `.appstore-screenshots` workspaces. Excludes general image generation.

items.name: appstore-screenshot-validator
items.description: App Store screenshot validation and upload with live `asc` size data and macOS `sips` to resize, strip alpha, and color-convert copies.

items.name: appstore-signing-setup
items.description: App Store signing asset setup with `asc` for bundle IDs, capabilities, certificates, profiles, local install, rotation, and encrypted team sync.

items.name: appstore-subscription-localizer
items.description: App Store subscription localization: create or update localized display names and descriptions for groups, subscriptions, and IAPs with `asc`; exclude app listing metadata, release notes, keywords, screenshots, and pricing.

items.name: appstore-testflight-coordinator
items.description: Coordinate TestFlight beta distribution, groups, testers, and What to Test notes with `asc` for beta rollouts.

items.name: appstore-wall-publisher
items.description: Submit or update Wall of Apps entries in the App-Store-Connect-CLI repository with `asc apps wall submit`; match wall submission, addition, or update requests.

items.name: appstore-workflow-runner
items.description: Manage `.asc/workflow.json` automations; define, validate, run, resume, and audit trusted repo-local release/TestFlight flows and step outputs with `asc workflow`.

items.name: build-swift-apps
items.description: Route broad or ambiguous Swift and Apple-platform work to a focused skill; this router does not implement domain work. Covers iOS, macOS, SwiftUI, Xcode, Simulator, App Store Connect, Tuist, SwiftPM, signing, profiling, and Apple research.

items.name: ios-ettrace-profiler
items.description: iOS ETTrace Simulator profiles: capture and interpret symbolicated startup, scrolling, navigation, rendering, CPU hotspots, and before/after evidence.

items.name: ios-intents-architect
items.description: Design and implement iOS App Intents, AppEntity, EntityQuery, and App Shortcuts for Siri, Spotlight, widgets, controls, Shortcuts, and app handoff routes.

items.name: ios-liquid-glass-designer
items.description: Implement, refactor, or review iOS 26+ SwiftUI Liquid Glass with native `glassEffect`, `GlassEffectContainer`, button styles, availability gates, and non-glass fallbacks.

items.name: ios-memgraph-inspector
items.description: iOS memgraph leak analysis: capture, inspect, compare, and prove memory leaks with Apple's `leaks` tool, retain-cycle evidence, and before/after checks.

items.name: ios-rocketsim-operator
items.description: RocketSim iOS Simulator UI: inspect and control accessibility state, gestures, typing, hardware buttons, and CLI automation.

items.name: ios-simulator-browser
items.description: Mirror iOS Simulator runs in the Codex browser for interaction, visible proof, and hot-reloaded SwiftUI previews from importable Swift packages; exclude headless or log-only debugging.

items.name: ios-simulator-debugger
items.description: Debug iOS Simulator apps with XcodeBuildMCP for build, run, launch, UI inspection, interaction, screenshots, and logs; route user-visible mirrors and SwiftUI previews to `ios-simulator-browser`.

items.name: ios-swiftui-architect
items.description: iOS SwiftUI views and components: build or refactor navigation, state ownership, async UI, sheets, previews, and responsive layouts; exclude UIKit-only and macOS work.

items.name: macos-appkit-bridge
items.description: macOS SwiftUI-AppKit bridges: implement NSViewRepresentable, NSViewControllerRepresentable, NSWindow, panels, responder chains, or menus only where pure SwiftUI cannot model the behavior.

items.name: macos-liquid-glass-designer
items.description: macOS SwiftUI Liquid Glass UI: modernize or review system materials, toolbars, search, controls, and custom glass; prefer native structure over hand-built chrome.

items.name: macos-notarization-packager
items.description: macOS distribution artifacts: inspect Developer ID archives, app bundles, hardened runtime, nested signing, and notarization readiness; exclude local signing-only diagnosis and direct `asc notarization` execution.

items.name: macos-runtime-debugger
items.description: macOS app runtimes: build, launch, and debug Xcode or SwiftPM GUI/CLI targets with shell-first workflows; diagnose compiler, linker, startup, log, and telemetry failures; exclude iOS Simulator work.

items.name: macos-signing-inspector
items.description: macOS app signing artifacts: inspect code signatures, entitlements, hardened runtime, sandbox, Gatekeeper, and trust failures; exclude distribution packaging and notarization submission.

items.name: macos-swiftpm-runner
items.description: macOS SwiftPM packages: build, run, and test package-first repositories and executables when `Package.swift` is primary or no Xcode project exists; not for Xcode-only app bundles.

items.name: macos-swiftui-architect
items.description: macOS SwiftUI scenes: build or refactor windows, commands, toolbars, settings, split views, inspectors, menu bar extras, keyboard flows, and desktop layouts; not AppKit-only behavior.

items.name: macos-telemetry-probe
items.description: macOS runtime telemetry: add and verify privacy-safe Logger/OSLog events, log stream filters, and signposts; not crash diagnosis.

items.name: macos-test-diagnoser
items.description: macOS Xcode and SwiftPM tests: run focused scopes and diagnose build, assertion, crash, async-flake, fixture, entitlement, and host-app failures; separate regressions from setup issues.

items.name: macos-view-architect
items.description: macOS SwiftUI view structure: refactor oversized scenes into subviews, explicit roots, scoped state, command/toolbar ownership, and narrow AppKit bridges.

items.name: macos-window-architect
items.description: macOS 15+ SwiftUI windows: customize toolbar/title chrome, drag regions, materials, minimize/restoration, placement, launch behavior, and borderless styles; prefer SwiftUI before NSWindow.

items.name: swiftpm-build-inspector
items.description: Diagnose SwiftPM graph overhead across dependencies, plugins, module variants, branch pins, macros, binary targets, and slow CI or local Xcode builds.

items.name: swiftui-performance-inspector
items.description: Diagnose SwiftUI rendering and update costs from code or profiles when scrolling janks, CPU or memory spikes, views update excessively, layouts thrash, or apps hang.

items.name: swiftui-view-architect
items.description: Refactor oversized SwiftUI view files into stable, dedicated subviews with MV-first data flow, explicit dependencies, extracted actions, and correct Observation usage.

items.name: tuist-flaky-test-stabilizer
items.description: Stabilize flaky Tuist tests identified by test-insights URLs, test case IDs, or inconsistent local runs; covers test and product-code causes.

items.name: tuist-generation-doctor
items.description: Diagnose Tuist generation, build, and launch failures when `tuist generate`, generated Xcode workspaces, or apps fail or diverge from the source project.

items.name: tuist-migration-planner
items.description: Plan Xcode-to-Tuist migrations for hand-maintained projects, including target, setting, and dependency mapping plus generated build, test, signing, and launch parity.

items.name: tuist-workspace-navigator
items.description: Operate Tuist-generated Xcode workspaces with `tuist generate`, focused generation, tags, buildable folders, and post-generation build or test commands.

items.name: xcode-build-baseline
items.description: Benchmark Xcode clean, cached-clean, zero-change, and incremental builds with fixed inputs, timing summaries, and `.build-benchmark/` artifacts.

items.name: xcode-build-strategist
items.description: Coordinate end-to-end Xcode build optimization audits with recommend-first, approval-gated fixes, specialist analysis, wall-clock priorities, and re-benchmark proof.

items.name: xcode-build-tuner
items.description: Implement approved Xcode build-speed fixes after strategist approval or explicit requests covering build settings, script phases, Swift compilation, or SwiftPM graphs; re-benchmark results.

items.name: xcode-compile-profiler
items.description: Profile Swift and mixed-language compile bottlenecks from timing summaries, frontend diagnostics, type-check warnings, CompileSwiftSources, and SwiftEmitModule; recommend changes only.

items.name: xcode-project-auditor
items.description: Audit Xcode project and target overhead across schemes, settings, dependencies, run scripts, module maps, and explicit modules; require approval before changes.

items.name: xcode-ui-test-stabilizer
items.description: Build and stabilize Xcode UI end-to-end tests with XCUIApplication/xcodebuild for new or unreliable automation, covering environment setup, focus/input reliability, waits, logs, attachments, and flakiness triage.
